methodology.timings: Per-frame CPU submission and rAF intervals; asynchronous GPU timestamp samples. Vite dev build, headless, exploratory, no sustained thermal test.

methodology.visual: RGBA pixel equality after fixed-step runs: cleanup 120 steps; trail-layout 180 steps, dtFrame=1/60.
